title: Fire Your Ceramics With Us – Cone 10 Gas Firing Service
evidence_quote: Fire Your Ceramics With Us Bring your work in and use our cone 10 gas kiln and glazes.
evidence_sentence: The home page advertises a firing service where potters can bring work to fire in the cone 10 gas kiln with studio glazes included.
how_to_join: Contact studio or book through website shop
source_quote: Fire Your Ceramics With Us Bring your work in and use our cone 10 gas kiln and glazes.
summary: Bring bisque-fired work to fire in Radius's cone 10 gas kiln. Studio glazes are available. Details and pricing available through website shop.
